Extremely disappointed with Nykaa’s worst delivery service and customer support. I placed my order on 4th August with an express delivery promise of 2 hours. However, the order was not delivered as promised, and the status simply showed “Order Delayed.”

I patiently waited until 7th August and contacted customer care. The response was extremely casual and showed absolutely no concern for the customer. I was repeatedly given false assurances that the order would be delivered by 10 PM on 7th August or by the morning of 8th August.

It is now 8th August, and I STILL haven’t received my order. This is completely unacceptable. If you cannot provide the delivery service you promise, you should not advertise 2-hour delivery in the first place.

The worst part is not even the delay—it is the careless attitude of the customer service team and the lack of any proper resolution. Customers are made to wait for days while customer care keeps giving the same meaningless assurances.

Very poor service, very poor customer support, and a complete waste of the customer’s time. I will seriously reconsider ordering from Nykaa again. Highly disappointing and absolutely NOT recommended.

It has been over 20 days, and I am still waiting for my order. What’s even more unacceptable is that the tracking status has shown “Out for Delivery” for the past 10 days, yet no delivery attempt has been made, and I haven’t received a single call from the delivery partner.
The most disappointing part of this experience has been the complete lack of customer support. Every interaction with the support team has resulted in nothing more than generic copy-and-paste responses, with no real effort to investigate or resolve the issue. As a customer, I expected accountability and timely assistance not automated replies that only add to the frustration.
For a brand that claims to be trusted, this level of negligence, poor communication, and lack of ownership is extremely disappointing. Keeping a customer waiting for over 20 days without any meaningful update or resolution is simply unacceptable and reflects a serious failure in customer service.
Nykaa has completely wasted my time and has shown little regard for its customers’ concerns. This has been one of the most frustrating online shopping experiences I have had. I strongly urge potential customers to reconsider before placing an order if they expect reliable delivery, transparent communication, and responsive customer support.

As a regular customer, I expected much better service, but I felt that my time and concerns were not respected. If the same product is available on Amazon or Tira, I strongly recommend purchasing it from those platforms instead. Based on my experience, they provide a much better overall customer experience.
